title: New Zealand archives reveal Kaikoura cover-up and squid boat explanation
summary: Ross Coulthart tells of New Zealand archives reveal Kaikoura cover-up and squid boat explanation, about 1978; released c. 2011 at New Zealand, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I discovered that there'd been this release of the New Zealand archives in about 2011.

plain: Ross Coulthart, an Australian journalist who investigates UFO claims, says he discovered that New Zealand released government archives around 2011 about the 1978 sightings of strange lights off Kaikoura, a stretch of the New Zealand coast. According to Coulthart, the files show a cover-up and how officials settled on explaining the lights as squid fishing boats, which use bright lamps at night. If he is right, the official explanation was a convenient story rather than a real answer.
